output.reason: On its own, [ev-62f57e8a5130] is just a metric name in a list. The section intro [ev-1f419676f177] explains what the list means: Loki metrics with the `cortex_` prefix "will be changed so they start with `loki_`", and these are the metrics affected. So the subject is the metric `cortex_query_frontend_retries_count`, and the change is a rename to `loki_query_frontend_retries_count`. The same text names the setting that decides who is exposed: anyone leaving `metrics_namespace` at its default `loki` gets the rename, and setting it to `cortex` keeps the old prefix (the setting is deprecated and due to be removed). The consequence follows from that: the metric is no longer published under its old name, so anything that queries `cortex_query_frontend_retries_count` stops finding it.
